# CTX protected surface — the success-definition surface
#
# Conservation-gates principle 1: "Separation of authorship — you do not edit
# the bar to pass." Every path below defines what counts as success. Changing
# one changes the bar, so it requires owner review.
#
# This file is the single source of truth. `scripts/gen_codeowners.py` renders
# it into .github/CODEOWNERS; CI fails if the two drift, so the bar cannot be
# quietly relocated. Real teeth come from branch protection: require CODEOWNERS
# review and disallow self-approval.
#
# Format: one glob per line. Blank lines and #-comments ignored.
# Order matters — CODEOWNERS applies the LAST matching rule.

# --- Owner-authored doctrine -------------------------------------------------
/CLAUDE.md
/AGENTS.md
/.claude/rules/

# --- The gates themselves ----------------------------------------------------
# A gate that the implementer can edit is not a gate.
/scripts/check_claims.py
/scripts/check_capability_registry.py
/scripts/check_doc_privacy.py
/scripts/check_release_manifest.py
/scripts/gen_codeowners.py
/scripts/check_pr_template.py

# --- CI definition -----------------------------------------------------------
/.github/workflows/
/.github/CODEOWNERS
/.github/pull_request_template.md

# --- The protected surface itself --------------------------------------------
/harness/structural-floor/

# --- Preregistrations: amended only by commit BEFORE a scored run ------------
/ctxpack/benchmarks/**/PREREGISTRATION*.md

# --- Immutable evidence: new runs write new versioned files ------------------
/ctxpack/benchmarks/**/results/

# --- Non-negotiable invariant tests ------------------------------------------
# Softening one of these silently removes a guarantee.
/tests/test_p0_trust_repairs.py
/tests/test_negation_preservation.py
/tests/test_protected_surface_sync.py
/tests/test_pr_template_gate.py
